notes.title: Warning: Important Notice Before Playing Winion Virus
notes.content:
Hello from DawnTown Studio!

First and foremost, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the incredible support you’ve shown for Winion Virus. Thanks to you, every day feels like a dream come true. 😊

That said, we’re aware that the game’s atmosphere and intense storytelling might cause emotional distress for some players.

Please remember that Winion Virus is strictly rated for mature audiences (18+).
[b]We kindly urge everyone to exercise caution when playing the game or watching streams of it.[/b]

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

Warm regards,
DawnTown Studio

notes.title: Temporary Deactivation of Desktop Mode
notes.content:
Hello, this is DawnTown Studio.
First of all, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all players who have shown their love and support for Winion Virus.


[b][Notice: Temporary Deactivation of Desktop Mode][/b]

To share the joy of our Winions with our players, we released the Desktop Mode early despite it being incomplete. However, due to numerous errors, we believe it may have negatively impacted your overall experience. As such, we have decided to temporarily deactivate Desktop Mode.


Thanks to the overwhelming support you’ve given our Winions, we have decided to cancel the initial plan for a paid release. Instead, Desktop Mode will be updated as a free DLC. We will do our best to deliver a more polished and enjoyable experience.


Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.

Sincerely,
Duntown Studio
